component.name: PrimeCare Governance
component.summary: Healthcare Platform Administration and Deployment Governance

description.p: PrimeCare Governance is the centralized administrative command center for the PrimeCare Healthcare Platform. It provides secure, real-time insights into system telemetry, deployment readiness across iOS, Android, Linux, Web, and Windows, and ensures full compliance with clinical regulatory standards.

Features include:
Cross-platform deployment status tracking.
Automated security and audit logging.
Real-time metrics and dynamic dashboard generation.
